flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Democrats are favoured to win control of the Senate, and their chances rose by a sizable amount in the Polymarket odds. The projected seat count is now 54-46, up from 53-47, which means Democrats gain control, and [[Iowa]] is a newly predicted flip as the Democrat Josh Turek gained notable ground. In [[South Carolina]], the Republican Darline Graham Nordone saw a sizable drop in their chances.
summaries.governor: The biggest shift came in [[Kansas]], where the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sharp drop in chances, and the market sees the seat as a predicted flip. In [[Vermont]], the Republican Phil Scott also slid sharply. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford lost a sizable amount of ground, and Polymarket odds mark that seat as a predicted flip as well.
summaries.house: The biggest move came in [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], where the Democrat Cait Conley saw a sharp drop in their chances, and the market lists the seat as a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott gained ground sharply. Over in [[AR-02 (Little Rock & Conway)]], the Republican French Hill slipped by a sizable amount in Polymarket odds.
